_comment: Machine-readable provenance & tunability registry for crystal_lake_v0.json. METADATA ONLY (values live in the artifact). class mirrors the calibration-log Confidence column; `tunable` gates what a future sweep/auto-calibrator may fit; full metadata (min/max/prior/couples_with) is carried only for the tunable set. Kept in sync with the artifact by tests/test_registry.py (completeness + consistency). Companion prose lives in docs/calibration-log.md.

hspf.PERC_coeff.source: 2026-06-12 gauge recession (~3.7 cfs sustained baseflow); re-derived with the true (statistics) rain on the live archive-replay spin-up
hspf.PERC_coeff.notes: 1 event, 1 season; the GAUGE is the anchor, not the HSPF nominal 0.1. Trades against the Step 6 flood-peak margin -- do not fit on RMSE alone.

hspf.AGWRC_per_day.source: moved off the Ecology Till nominal 0.996 to fit local post-rain lake hold; inside EPA Tech Note 6 typical 0.92-0.99
hspf.AGWRC_per_day.notes: recession half-life ~23 d at 0.97; the seasonal_agw_default_in table is DERIVED from this -- recompute it if AGWRC changes.

spillway.leakage.cfs_per_ft2.source: 0 since 2026-11-04: with open-water evaporation modeled, the summer dry-equilibrium holds at 339.667 with no seam seepage (the ~0.6 cfs once attributed to leakage was evaporation); operator reports no outflow through the boards
spillway.leakage.cfs_per_ft2.notes: Mechanism kept (linear in submerged seam height, both legs). Re-fit only from a gauge-clean dry spell with evaporation computed alongside; a nonzero value must then come with a matching evaporation re-check.

seasonal_agw_default_in.source: recharge-fraction estimate (Bauer & Mastin 1997, ~13-23% of precip under forested till)
seasonal_agw_default_in.notes: PROVISIONAL placeholder; DERIVED from AGWRC (recompute if it changes). Tune against gauge dry-spell baseflow + Wolock BFI~0.67. Per-cell tuning deferred (whole-table).

watershed.lag_hours.source: doc '4-5 h' ballpark + one suspect dashboard read
watershed.lag_hours.notes: weakly grounded; a pure translation delay (affects timing, not delivery duration). Rounds to lag_steps=round(lag_hours/dt).

datum.sensor_to_absolute_offset_ft.source: cross-checked from the HA summer_normal helper + a hindcast
datum.sensor_to_absolute_offset_ft.notes: UNCONFIRMED within ~0.12 ft (two soft anchors disagree); propagates to every absolute threshold. Needs a clean crest-crossing field read.

hspf.INTFW.notes: Ecology Till value; currently reserved/unused pending a SURO path (#3).

hspf.INFEXP.notes: HSPF Till nonlinearity of percolation; drove the #3 wetness-driven interflow fraction too until IFEXP was split out (2026-11-14).

hspf.IFEXP.notes: interflow-generation exponent, (SM/LZSN)**IFEXP; 2.0 (= INFEXP) -> 3.0 from the fall 2026 below-crest storms, mainly Nov 9-10. Lowers Step 6 342.80 -> 342.72. Re-check on a storm onto a wet basin (2026-11-14 log entry).

hspf.KVARY_per_in.notes: held at 0 (linear store); Ecology Till is 0.5/in -- enable later (brief D.5).

hspf.DEEPFR.notes: 0.05 low end for a low-relief closed till basin; EPA range 0.0-0.50.

lake_evaporation_in_per_day.source: on-site FAO-56 reference ET (carport T/RH + WH85 wind, Jun-Aug) and lake-probe mass transfer (Sep-Nov), 2026; cross-checked by no-outflow lake drawdown
lake_evaporation_in_per_day.notes: Dec-May extrapolated: the replacement lake probe (reads to at least freezing) only started 2026-09-03, the old one had a 40 F floor. Re-derive from this winter's probe + carport data; a daily station-driven estimate could replace the monthly table.

lake_evaporation_model.longitude_deg.notes: site longitude (WeatherKit entity coordinates); locates the NWS forecast grid cell.

lake_evaporation_model.elevation_m.notes: ~340 ft site elevation; only sets air pressure in FAO-56.

lake_evaporation_model.timezone.notes: local day for the daily means / temperature range (America/Los_Angeles).

lake_evaporation_model.hargreaves_krs.notes: FAO-56 Hargreaves radiation coefficient: 0.16 interior, 0.19 coastal; 0.175 midpoint.

baseflow_assimilation.window_days.notes: water-balance window before T0 (whole 24 h blocks cancel the gauge's daily cycle).

baseflow_assimilation.min_days.notes: baseflow assimilation gate (2026-11-05); set from the Jul-Nov 2026 archive replay.

baseflow_assimilation.min_hours_per_day.notes: baseflow assimilation gate (2026-11-05); set from the Jul-Nov 2026 archive replay.

baseflow_assimilation.max_window_rain_in.notes: skip wetter windows: rain beyond this makes quickflow error leak into the baseflow fit.

baseflow_assimilation.max_model_quickflo.notes: skip windows where the model itself gives storm runoff.

baseflow_assimilation.max_se_cfs.notes: skip when the observed-inflow standard error exceeds this.

baseflow_assimilation.min_model_baseflow.notes: below this the model has no baseflow worth scaling.

baseflow_assimilation.scale_min.notes: lower bound on the groundwater-store scale (0 = the lake shows no inflow).

baseflow_assimilation.scale_max.notes: upper bound when the lake runs higher than the model (the cautious direction).

baseflow_assimilation.crest_margin_ft.notes: skip windows within this of the spillway crest (outflow would enter the balance).

deep_zone.capacity_in.notes: deep-zone capacity, inches over the watershed; 2-6 in fit about as well. Hand-fitted to June 2026 vs the fall 2026 storms (2026-11-14 log entry).

deep_zone.et_coeff.notes: share of the soil's unmet ET demand the zone supplies when full; below ~1 spring recharge leaks into the fall, above it June drains.

deep_zone.gate_exp.notes: recharge = perc * (S_dz/capacity)**gate_exp; 1-2 fit about as well.

lake_filter.history_hours.notes: the filter re-runs over this trailing window on every call (stateless).

lake_filter.noise_sd_ft.notes: white part of the gauge's reading error. Prototype value (9 days of 1-minute readings); retuned by lake-filter-study.

lake_filter.offset_sd_ft.notes: stationary sd of the gauge's persistent offset.

lake_filter.offset_minutes.notes: the offset's AR(1) time constant; the readings' offsets persist ~15-20 min.

lake_filter.level_sd_ft.notes: per-minute process sd of the level.

lake_filter.scale_sd.notes: per-minute random walk of the inflow scale (the model's watershed-inflow error).

lake_filter.rate_sd_dry_ft_per_min.notes: per-minute random walk of the residual rate when dry: heavy smoothing.

lake_filter.rate_sd_wet_ft_per_min.notes: per-minute random walk of the residual rate when fully wet (or rain unknown): the gauge steers quickly.

lake_filter.init_scale_sd.notes: initial sd of the inflow scale (starts at 1).

lake_filter.init_rate_sd_ft_per_h.notes: initial sd of the residual rate (starts at 0).

lake_filter.scale_max.notes: clamp on the inflow scale, so a wild estimate can't drive the level.

lake_filter.gate_sigmas.notes: Huber gate: a larger innovation inflates the measurement variance (a 1 ft spike moves the level < 0.005 ft).

lake_filter.wet_window_hours.notes: trailing rain window for the filter's wetness.

lake_filter.wet_full_in.notes: rain over the window that makes the filter fully wet.

lake_filter.min_valid_minutes_last_30.notes: fewer valid readings in the last 30 min -> no estimate (the 30-min median stands).

geometry.stage_area.slope.notes: linear area fit; enforced by test_geometry_matches_documented_hard_points (75.1/96.1 ac).

geometry.stage_storage.a.notes: quadratic storage fit; enforced by geometry hard points (131/230/486 ac-ft).

stop_logs.log_height_ft.notes: ~5 in per log added (user, 2026-11-25 survey); the EAP's pool levels imply ~4 in.

stop_logs.primary.crest_one_log_stick_ft.notes: laser-level survey vs the stick, 2026-11-25: top of the main's three base boards = '1 log'.

stop_logs.primary.logs_below_one_log.notes: 0: the main's base boards stay in at 0 logs.

stop_logs.primary.mortared_boards.notes: the bottom base board is mortared in place; the other two come out only in an emergency (user, 2026-11-25).

stop_logs.auxiliary.crest_one_log_stick_.notes: laser-level survey vs the stick, 2026-11-25: top of the aux's single log.

stop_logs.auxiliary.logs_below_one_log.notes: 1: the aux's single log comes out at 0 logs.

stop_logs.summer_count.notes: EAP summer normal stop logs = 2 logs.

stop_logs.winter_count.notes: EAP winter normal stop logs (0.97 ft) = 1 log (user, 2026-11-25).

stop_logs.board_counts_before.notes: when the operator helper switched from main-spillway boards to EAP logs; earlier recorded counts read as count - 1.

spillway.primary.rated_crest_elev_ft.notes: the crest the documented 110 cfs was rated over; sets C only.

spillway.primary.soffit_elev_ft.notes: INFERRED from the rated 110 cfs; estimate pending a field measurement of the primary opening.

spillway.auxiliary.rated_crest_elev_ft.notes: the crest the documented 40 cfs was rated over; sets C only. The aux spills over its stop-log crest (stop_logs), not a fixed 340.0 (2026-11-25).

spillway.auxiliary.soffit_elev_ft.notes: measured 2.5 ft above the zero-stop-log datum.

spillway.weir_exponent.notes: 1.5 corroborated (both legs imply C~1.9); enforced by test_m6_physical_crest_lengths_corroborate_reported_capacity. Do NOT change without strong cause.

spillway.overtopping.bridge_deck_elev_ft.notes: EAP-grounded relative 0.5 ft sag->bridge; absolute tied to dam-crest.

seasonal_sm_default_frac_of_lzsn.notes: monthly SM seeding fraction of LZSN (Reference 1.5).

ensemble_rain.source.notes: qpf_archive source whose members drive the live forecast; ECMWF beat NBM once calibrated (2026-11-14 log entry).

ensemble_rain.max_run_age_h.notes: a run is normally 9-21 h old when used; older means the hourly qpf job has stalled, so fall back to the point forecast's band.

ensemble_rain.agreement_tolerance_ft.notes: forecast agreement = share of members whose peak is within this of the middle case's; about the gauge's daily wobble. Display only.

ensemble_rain.calibration_by_day.notes: per-lead-day square-root-space bias/spread correction of the members, fitted to the gauge over 2026-02-21..11-13 (2026-11-14 log entry). Refit as the archive grows.

uncertainty.lead_ratio_by_day.notes: PLACEHOLDER low/high precip band by lead; needs the spec-3.5 forecast-vs-gauge fit.

uncertainty.skill_confidence_by_day.notes: PLACEHOLDER QPF-skill-by-lead; ordinal, not a calibrated probability (spec 3.5).

uncertainty.season_spread_factor.notes: PLACEHOLDER seasonal band widener; no independent grounding.

uncertainty.noaa_median_fraction.notes: #2 fix; 0.5 ~ median/high ratio of the day-2/3 band. Tune once spec-3.5 pairs exist.

validation_targets.step6_storm_total_in.notes: HEC-HMS Step 6 design storm; an anchor, not a tunable model parameter.

validation_targets.step6_peak_elev_ft.notes: modeled design-flood cross-check (343.1); revisit as an anchor, don't fit hydrology to it.

validation_targets.dry_equilibrium_summe.notes: observed dry-equilibrium band 339.6-339.8 at summer normal stop logs (2 logs since 2026-11-25) -- the one empirically-grounded anchor.

units.CFS_TO_ACFT_PER_HR.notes: physical constant 0.0826 (units.py); not in the artifact -- cannot be --set.

sources.live_ha.LIVE_ANCHOR_WINDOW_HOURS.notes: 30-min live anchor median window; empirically tuned to sensor noise. Do NOT lengthen without re-checking alarm lag.
